This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
Estimate the total food energy of everything on the plate, in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"total_kcal": <number>}

Plate contains: two pizza slices (one cheese slice, one slice with meat/sausage, roughly two slices total visible — actually three wedge pieces: one cheese slice on top-left, and two pieces on right side), plus a chocolate chip cookie.

Estimate: a slice of cheese/pizza ~285 kcal each; the image shows about 3 pizza pieces (left slice, and two right pieces, the right ones appear to be one larger slice split into two). Taking ~2.5 slices at ~280 kcal = ~700 kcal. Chocolate chip cookie (dark, possibly double chocolate) ~200 kcal.

Total ≈ 900 kcal.

{"total_kcal": 900}
